text: Add fiat-to-crypto to your product without building your own payments, KYC, and compliance
quote: MoonPay lets you add fiat-to-crypto to your product without rebuilding payments, KYC, and compliance.

text: Hosted on-ramp and off-ramp widget you embed in your app, with MoonPay running KYC, payments, and UI
quote: A hosted on-ramp and off-ramp you embed in your app. MoonPay runs the KYC, payments, and UI.

text: Build your own on-ramp and off-ramp UI and flow on MoonPay's APIs and SDKs
quote: Build your own on-ramp and off-ramp on MoonPay's APIs and SDKs. Your UI, your flow, our rails.

text: Connect existing MoonPay users with stored payment and KYC details so they skip re-onboarding
quote: Connect existing MoonPay usersSkip re-onboarding. Plug into the existing MoonPay account base.

text: Embed co-branded payment and onboarding frames built on headless APIs
quote: Embed payment and onboarding framesCo-branded UI components on top of headless APIs.

text: Documentation MCP server lets AI agents search and retrieve docs content
quote: The documentation includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents direct access to search and retrieve content.

text: GitHub repo of clone-able demo integrations that work once you add your API keys
quote: The MoonPay Demo Integrations GitHub repository has working, clone-able example integrations ready to use - just add your API keys.

text: Customize widget button and background colors, and add your logo to transactional emails
quote: You can customize the widget to feel like a native part of your site or application by adjusting button and background colors. You can also add your company logo to the transactional emails sent to customers.

text: Pre-fill wallet address, email, token, fiat currency, amount, and payment method in the purchase flow
quote: Improve your customers' experience and speed up the buying process by pre-filling information such as their wallet address, email, selected token, fiat currency, amounts, and their preferred payment method.

text: Create a wallet for users who don't have one, using only their email during purchase
quote: Users don't have a digital wallet? We can create one for them using just their email address as they go through the purchase flow.

text: Webhook events alert your app to asynchronous transaction status updates
quote: They allow you to receive alerts for asynchronous updates to transaction statuses.

text: Sell requote webhook lets you show in-app notifications when a sell price changes
quote: Handle the sell_transaction_requote_required webhook to surface in-app requote notifications when a sell price changes.

text: Test mode and sandbox use testnet blockchains and simulated payments, with no real assets moved
quote: MoonPay provides a test mode for integration development and testing. Test mode uses testnet blockchains and simulated payments. No real assets are transferred.

text: Using a test API key with the widget URL automatically switches it to the sandbox
quote: Using your test API key with this widget URL will automatically switch the environment to our sandbox.

text: Buy quotes return a locked rate, fees, limits, and a signature for execution, and expire after a short window
quote: Builds a quote for a fiat-to-crypto buy. Returns locked rate, fees, and signature for payment execution.

text: Create a session token and use it to initialize a reusable SDK client
quote: Initialize a reusable SDK client with a `sessionToken`.

text: Buy crypto with card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank transfers, and wires
quote: Use a card, Apple Pay or Google Pay to buy crypto fast. We also accept bank transfers and wires.

text: On-ramp supports local payment methods in addition to cards and Apple Pay
quote: Buy crypto with fiatOn-ramp with cards, Apple Pay, and local payment methods.

text: Sell crypto for cash paid out to a bank account or Visa card
quote: Turn your crypto into cash. In a flash. Get paid straight to your bank account or Visa card.

text: In-widget sell flow: confirm asset and amount, log in with MFA, then choose a payout method
quote: To sell crypto, the user goes through the following steps in the widget: 1. Confirm the cryptocurrency, fiat, and amount to sell. 2. Log in to the widget using multi-factor authentication (MFA). 3. Select payout method.

text: Swap between tokens, including across different chains with built-in bridging
quote: Trade between tokens, even if they're on different chains (we make bridging seamless too).

text: Guest checkout lets new customers buy with Apple Pay or Google Pay without a MoonPay account
quote: Let new customers buy crypto with Apple Pay or Google Pay without a MoonPay account.

text: Guest checkout limit upgrades are offered through a challenge URL returned on the buy quote
quote: returned as `challenge.url` on a buy quote for [guest checkout limit upgrades]

text: Widget login uses multi-factor authentication
quote: Log in to the widget using multi-factor authentication (MFA).

text: OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the Developer Platform API, usable to generate typed clients in any language
quote: The MoonPay Developer Platform API is defined using an OpenAPI 3.1 specification. You can use this spec to generate typed clients for any language.

text: Web SDK for building fiat-to-crypto ramps with headless payments
quote: Use the Web SDK to build fiat-to-crypto ramps with headless payments.

text: Web SDK targets browser apps and ships TypeScript types
quote: The Web SDK targets first-party browser apps. It ships with TypeScript types for autocomplete and inference.

text: React Native SDK for iOS and Android apps
quote: @moonpay/platform-sdk-react-native — for iOS and Android apps built with React Native.

text: Drive frames directly without the SDK on iOS, Android, or Flutter
quote: Skip the SDK and drive frames directly. Use this on iOS, Android, or Flutter, or when you prefer not to bundle a third-party SDK.

text: SDK method checks whether the customer already has an active MoonPay connection
quote: Use this method to check whether the current customer already has an active connection.

text: Mount a co-branded connect flow in your UI that streams lifecycle events to an onEvent handler
quote: This method mounts the co-branded connect flow into your UI and streams lifecycle events through `onEvent`.

text: Clear the customer's MoonPay connection in the browser when they sign out
quote: Use this method to clear the customer's MoonPay connection in the current browser when they sign out of your app.

text: List a customer's available payment methods and cards on file
quote: Use this method to list the customer's available payment methods, plus any cards they have on file.

text: Remove a stored payment method, for example when a customer asks to forget a card
quote: Use this method to remove a stored payment method — for example, when a customer asks to forget a card

text: Render the buy widget in your UI and start a transaction from a quote signature
quote: Render the MoonPay buy widget into your UI and initiate a transaction with a quote signature.

text: Buy frame renders a single card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay button that runs the buy pipeline on tap
quote: The frame renders a single payment button (card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay) matching the payment method in the quote, and runs the buy pipeline on tap.

text: Headless buy frame has no visible UI and emits events you handle from your own purchase screen
quote: The frame renders no visible UI — it drives the buy pipeline in the background and emits events you handle from your own purchase screen.

text: Google Pay frame renders in your UI and starts a transaction from a quote signature
quote: Render the Google Pay frame into your UI and initiate a transaction with a quote signature.

text: Card data is captured in a PCI-compliant MoonPay-hosted UI and never touches your domain
quote: Card data is captured inside a PCI-compliant MoonPay-hosted UI and never touches your domain.

text: Self-driving challenge frame runs through all required verification steps and emits complete when done
quote: the challenge frame is self-driving — after initialization, it sequences through all required verification steps and emits `complete` when the pipeline finishes.

text: Auth frame authenticates customers with email and a one-time passcode
quote: Render the Auth frame into your UI to authenticate the customer with email and a one-time passcode.

text: Forward the customer's accessToken to your backend and call the Platform API server-side on their behalf
quote: forward the accessToken to your own backend and call the MoonPay Platform API server-side on that customer's behalf.

text: Capture KYC data in your own screens and submit it through the Customer API
quote: The API-driven path: capture KYC data in your own screens and submit it with the Customer API.

text: Supports 100+ cryptocurrencies
quote: Our system supports 100+ cryptocurrencies and as the merchant of record MoonPay assumes full responsibility for all fraud disputes and chargebacks.

text: MoonPay acts as merchant of record and takes full responsibility for fraud disputes and chargebacks
quote: Our system supports 100+ cryptocurrencies and as the merchant of record MoonPay assumes full responsibility for all fraud disputes and chargebacks.

text: Integrate the widget as a modal overlay in a web app or in an in-app web view
quote: there are several options to integrate MoonPay widget. For example, in a modal overlaid on top of your web app, or in an in-app web view.

text: Widget handles the full purchase flow, including payment, verification, and confirmation, inside an iframe
quote: The widget handles the full purchase flow — including payment collection, verification, and transaction confirmation — inside an iframe.

text: Buy DeFi tokens by passing their CAIP-19 identifier from the list assets endpoint
quote: DeFi tokens — pass destination.caip19, the CAIP-19 identifier returned by the list assets endpoint.

text: Accept bank transfers over local rails and SWIFT and auto-convert incoming fiat into stablecoins via one API
quote: accept bank transfers through local payment rails and SWIFT, and automatically convert incoming fiat into stablecoins through one API platform.

text: Issue fiat-backed stablecoins with built-in minting, redemption, compliance, onboarding, and distribution
quote: Issue fiat-backed stablecoins with built-in minting, redemption, compliance, onboarding, and distribution infrastructure.
